sonnet.problem: The answer 'charges' is already shown on earlier cards. Card 5's question says 'against their charges' and card 17's question says 'definite charges'. So the fill-in-the-blank on 25:27 is given away by cards that come before it. Card 17 (25:26, nothing definite to write) and card 19 (25:27, unreasonable to send a prisoner without specifying the charges) also ask about the same point. sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later. ... Two lines that make the same point get one question. An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
